therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Stage III unresectable non-small cell lung cancer patients following concurrent chemoradiotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) as assessed by Independent Review Committee

results.target_engagement_evidence: Ociperlimab serum concentrations: predose 34.54-81.35 ug/ml, postdose 312-339.31 ug/ml; Tislelizumab serum concentrations: predose 15.91-41.29 ug/ml, postdose 72.20-100.26 ug/ml
biomarker_changes: PD-L1 and TIGIT expression measured in tumor tissues
results.dose_information: Ociperlimab 900 mg IV every 3 weeks; Tislelizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks; Durvalumab 10 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks or 1500 mg IV every 4 weeks

context.duration: Planned 20 months, terminated early at 16 months maximum treatment duration
